# connect

common

@[ExperimentalLiveApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-live-api/index.html)

open suspend fun [connect](connect.html)(request: [LlmRequest](../-llm-request/index.html)): [LiveConnection](../-live-connection/index.html)

Opens a live (bidirectional streaming) connection, configured by [LlmRequest.liveConnectConfig](../-llm-request/live-connect-config.html).

The returned connection is open but not yet primed; send history or content to start the conversation, and close it when it ends.

#### Parameters

 _request_

The request whose live config, model name, system instruction and tools configure the session.

#### Throws

[UnsupportedOperationException](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-unsupported-operation-exception/index.html)

if this model does not support live connections.
